versions.content: If an L-PDU is requested to be transmitted via a PDU channel mode, which equals CANIF_OFFLINE , the CanIf shall report the runtime error code CANIF_E_STOPPED to the Det_ReportRuntimeError() service of the DET and CanIf_Transmit() shall return E_NOT_OK .
